Overview

Štip is a city in Eastern with a population of 43,000. A city in eastern North Macedonia on the Bregalnica River, known for its textile industry, the Isar Fortress, and the annual Štip Cultural Summer festival. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
